sections.title: Qualitative Paradigm Empirical Nursing Research
sections.description: Study of selected qualitative paradigm empirical research approaches, including design and methodology. Critique of selected qualitative research reports from the literature of nursing and related disciplines. Fieldwork exercise and research proposal required. Prerequisite: PhD Students
